name: Ducky
source:
A small town fairy, Ducky,  dreams of leaving the only place they've ever known, all possible with the generous help of an elder monster hunter named Gerrit.

Despite neither wanting to settle for a life of simplicity, they can't help but long for each other's company, even when they are meant to part ways at the end of their journey.

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/ducky]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小镇仙女达基 (Ducky) 梦想离开他们唯一熟悉的地方，这一切都得益于年长的怪物猎人格里特 (Gerrit) 的慷慨帮助。

尽管两人都不想安于简单的生活，但他们还是忍不住渴望彼此的陪伴，即使他们注定要在旅程结束时分道扬镳。

[来自[url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/ducky]itch.io[/url]]
